title: PPG review-intelligence pilot — operator guide
subject: Discharge Summary — Completion & Distribution Procedure
notice: Held for current procedure/template verification. Historical V6 content and provisional suggestions are available; they are not a verified review of the requested V7 edition.

sections.title: 1. Confirm the source and preserve originals
steps: Check requested edition and template authority. Both remain unverified in this pilot.
Use the exact-byte archive for the historical V6 original and inspection inventory; preserve tracked changes and attachments.
Read catalogue coverage before interpreting a retrieval match as a comparison.

links.label: Open catalogue coverage and reference leads

sections.hold: Hold current-edition conclusions and mandatory template checks until verified sources exist.

sections.title: 2. Inspect and edit structured draft content
steps: Open Draft body modules; use ReviewText and ReviewedModule for your proposed edits.
Keep SourceText and source identities unchanged. StableSectionId needs deliberate section reconciliation.
Use the complete capture and original archive for headers, comments, tables, images and unresolved content. The conversion is an inspection aid, not verified Word parity.
sections.hold: Do not regenerate over human edits or treat proposed modules as approved mandatory rules.

sections.title: 3. Review evidence-backed suggestions
steps: Open the latest historical review pack and its preserved passage citations.
Use the criteria register as an advisory checklist, recording missing evidence explicitly.
The three current suggestions are provisional historical observations; wider semantic comparison remains incomplete.
sections.hold: No finding establishes current-policy deficiency, compliance or an authorised decision.

sections.title: 4. Capture suggestions and reconcile versions
steps: Add a suggestion to the annotation register with document version, section locator where known and evidence.
Keep original wording. Use append-only additions and a rationale when recording disposition.
Received, Triaged, Deferred and Accepted remain unresolved until incorporated or otherwise disposed of. Reconcile historical annotations to the current edition before incorporation.
sections.hold: Suggestion acceptance is separate from clinical approval, publication and role assignment.

sections.title: 5. Review standards and document links
steps: Keep second edition and third-edition draft mappings distinct. Draft material is not a current obligation.
Inspect proposed mappings and reference targets against actual passages and applicable editions.
Six reference candidates are Proposed; one target is unidentified. Title matches alone do not establish duplication, conflicts or consolidation.
sections.hold: Accepted hierarchy and supersession history are distinct; preserve evidence and reject circular authority links.

sections.title: 6. Maintain role responsibilities and dated output
steps: Keep stable roles separate from assignments and effective-dated appointments. Preserve earlier holders and decisions.
Record acting appointments, delegation scope, vacancies and accepted handovers with evidence. A portfolio transfer is a separate action.
Dated output refresh is on demand. Select one run and inspect its as-of date/source identity. Current native examples are fictional technical data only.
sections.hold: Role records grant neither SharePoint access nor clinical authority; a stored snapshot is not a live owner service.

sections.title: 7. Inspect quiet source surveillance
steps: Read the source register and exact capture comparison. Two selected NSQHS sources were unchanged in the qualified pair.
Changed bytes may be formatting; failed reads are exceptions, not no-change results. Missing relationships leave affected scope unassessed.
The bridge prepares deduplicated review leads through recorded standards relationships. No schedule, owner alert or automatic baseline promotion is enabled.

links.label: Open source register, captures and signals

sections.hold: No monitoring result determines applicability, changes policy content or notifies an owner automatically.

sections.title: 8. Record the human next action
steps: Use the decision vocabulary to consider retain, revise, consolidate, split, adopt/adapt, change type, pathway placement, supersede, withdraw or further evidence.
Record the authorised human decision and evidence in the existing case process; the vocabulary register itself records no decisions.
Keep review progress, document lifecycle, suggestion state, approval, publication and responsibility separate. Preserve issued history.
sections.hold: This guide issues no policy, assigns no person, changes no access and enables no AI or stopped pilot.
